cards.Dictionary Meaning (English): The fundamental, ineffable principle or path that underlies and governs all existence.
cards.Nuance (English): Implies something beyond ordinary human understanding, often associated with the Daoist concept of the Dao.
cards.Sentence Translations (English): The Dao that can be spoken of is not the eternal Dao; the name that can be named is not the eternal name;
cards.Sentences: S道可道，非常道，名可名，非常名；

cards.Dictionary Meaning (English): A physical or metaphorical route taken by a person or thing.
cards.Nuance (English): May imply a journey or direction, but not the metaphysical sense.
cards.Sentence Translations (English): The road is distant and dangerous, not to be taken lightly.|The traveler saw a path and asked someone: 'Where is this place?'|There is a tree by the road, its leaves very dense.|I wish to follow the path, but fear no one will guide me.
cards.Sentences: 道遠而險，不可輕行。|行者見道，問於人曰：「此何處也？」|道旁有樹，其葉甚茂。|吾欲從道而行，恐無人導之。
